groups.title: Start here
groups.blurb: Set up the machine, see where it stands, keep it current.

commands.name: init
commands.summary: The setup wizard: asks the questions, shows a review, then runs the matching commands.

commands.name: refresh
commands.summary: Put a managed config back to what BxCachy ships, with a backup first and without installing anything.
commands.note: A file you edited is kept and reported; --force overwrites it after a backup (see config history and config restore). --starter also rewrites the starter hyprland.lua or Noctalia config.toml, which are yours.

commands.name: reinstall
commands.summary: Run the setup wizard again from your saved answers (the same as init --rerun).
commands.note: This is the way to install packages again. refresh only puts config files back.

commands.name: wizard
commands.summary: Wizard pieces for scripts: render the demo screens or a pages file.

commands.name: status
commands.summary: What is installed and configured on this machine, compared with what BxCachy would do.

commands.name: doctor
commands.summary: Checks the machine (Arch or CachyOS, pacman, sudo, disk) and reports problems.

commands.name: update
commands.summary: Check for a BxCachy update, apply it, pick a channel, turn the daily notification on or off.
usage: update check [--notify] | apply [--yes] | channel [stable|beta] | notifications on|off|status [--json]
commands.note: Exit 10 from `update check` means an update is available.

commands.name: version
commands.summary: The BxCachy version and build.

commands.name: menu
commands.summary: The control center: every command as a menu on your launcher (Rofi, Walker, Wofi, Fuzzel or Vicinae).
usage: menu | menu items [--json] | menu search TEXT [--json]
commands.note: Bind it to a key; the first entry, Search, lists every entry as one flat list.

commands.name: apps
commands.summary: Your installed catalog apps, as a list or a launcher grid.

commands.name: help
commands.summary: This list, or the usage of one command.

groups.title: Install and remove
groups.blurb: Apps from the catalog, any package from the repositories or the AUR, and the reverse.

commands.name: install
commands.summary: Install catalog apps by id (or a whole group or profile).
commands.note: With no name it installs the default set; without --yes it prints the plan and changes nothing.

commands.name: remove
commands.summary: Uninstall catalog apps (their packages or web launchers).
commands.note: Protected packages (the base system, the kernel, bxcachy itself) are refused.

commands.name: pkg
commands.summary: Search, inspect, install and remove any package from the repositories and the AUR.
usage: pkg search TEXT [--source=all|repo|aur] [--limit=N] | info NAME | installed [--explicit] | install NAME... [--aur] [--yes] [--dry-run] | remove NAME... [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: catalog
commands.summary: Browse the app catalog.
usage: catalog list [--group=G] [--category=C] [--tier=default|optional] [--kind=K] [--source=S] [--json] | show ID | groups | check | version

commands.name: plan
commands.summary: Show what installing would do, without doing it.

commands.name: install-plan
commands.summary: The install plan for the selection (same as plan).

commands.name: optional-plan
commands.summary: The plan for the optional apps.

commands.name: profile-plan
commands.summary: The plan for one profile.

commands.name: profile-install-plan
commands.summary: The install steps for one profile.

commands.name: profile-install
commands.summary: Install a profile (jvm, containers, terminal, editors, ...).

commands.name: optional-install
commands.summary: Install the optional apps of the catalog.

commands.name: profile-list
commands.summary: List the profiles.

commands.name: optional-list
commands.summary: List the optional apps.

commands.name: desktop-list
commands.summary: List the desktop apps in the catalog.

commands.name: tui-list
commands.summary: List the terminal apps in the catalog.

commands.name: web-list
commands.summary: List the web apps in the catalog.

commands.name: package-status
commands.summary: Whether a catalog app is installed.

commands.name: package-source
commands.summary: Where a catalog app comes from (pacman, AUR, PKGBUILD, web).

commands.name: dev-plan
commands.summary: What the developer toolchain install would use: Java 21, Maven, Gradle, BVM, MVM.

commands.name: prerequisites
commands.summary: What BxCachy needs on the machine before anything else.

commands.name: apps-doctor
commands.summary: Checks the catalog apps for missing or broken installs.

commands.name: web
commands.summary: Web apps: create one from a URL, install a set (Google, Microsoft, Apple, BoxLang).
usage: web add [NAME URL] [--browser=brave|chromium|google-chrome|edge|firefox] [--yes] | list | rm NAME [--yes] | install google|microsoft|apple|boxlang|all [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: toolchain
commands.summary: Language toolchains outside the always-installed BoxLang one (Node via nvm, Rust, Python, Go, PHP).
usage: toolchain node [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]   (Bun and Deno: bxcachy install bun deno)

groups.title: Desktop setup
groups.blurb: Hyprland with Noctalia, or KDE Plasma beside it: the session, the keys, the defaults.

commands.name: setup
commands.summary: Set up a desktop: Hyprland with Noctalia, Plasma with HyprKwin tiling, terminals, keyboards, status.
usage: setup plasma [--keys | --undo-keys] | hyprland [--terminal=ghostty|kitty|alacritty|foot|konsole] [--layout=dwindle|master|scrolling|floating] [--workspaces=N] [--natural-scroll] [--layouts=us-intl,es] [--theme=dark|light|auto] [--wallpaper=box|grid|aurora|minimal] | terminal [--default=ghostty] [--also=a,b] | shell [--shell=zsh|fish|bash] | keyboard [--layouts=us-intl,es] | xremap [--build=hypr|kde] | undo plasma|hyprland|xremap | status [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: session
commands.summary: Which desktop SDDM starts: Hyprland or Plasma.

commands.name: tiling
commands.summary: Tiling inside Plasma (HyprKwin): on, off, status, layouts.

commands.name: plasma
commands.summary: Plasma extras: panel layouts (apply, undo, status) and the islands preset.
usage: plasma panels apply [--agenda] [--without-weather] [--desktops=N] [--preset=NAME] | undo | status [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]  |  plasma desktops N [--yes]

commands.name: keys
commands.summary: The shortcut table: show, check conflicts, apply to Hyprland and Plasma, Mac-style keys.
usage: keys show | mac [on|off|status] [--yes] | set ID KEYS [--yes] [--force] | reset ID [--yes] | conflicts | render xremap|hyprland|plasma | check | apply [--yes] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json]

commands.name: runner
commands.summary: Which launcher and which menu program BxCachy uses (Rofi, Walker, Wofi, Fuzzel, Vicinae).
usage: runner list | show | doctor | launch | select JSON_ENTRIES [--prompt=TEXT] | set PROVIDER | menu-set PROVIDER | launcher-command PROVIDER JSON_ARGV | menu-command PROVIDER JSON_ARGV [--json]

commands.name: default
commands.summary: Default apps: browser, terminal, file manager.
usage: default show | browser ID | terminal ID | filemanager ID [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: layout
commands.summary: Window layout at runtime: tile or float (toggle).

commands.name: assets
commands.summary: Brand assets (logo, icon, wallpapers): list, or install them.

commands.name: config
commands.summary: The managed config files: list, diff, apply, restore a backup, history. A file you edited is never overwritten.
usage: config list|diff NAME|apply NAME|restore NAME ID|history [NAME] [--yes] [--dry-run] [--force] [--json]
commands.note: BxCachy never overwrites a file you edited; `config status` shows which ones are yours.

groups.title: Look and feel
groups.blurb: Themes, fonts, bar, dock, windows, monitors and power.

commands.name: theme
commands.summary: Themes: 15 bundled (10 from Omarchy, 5 BxCachy), set one, light or dark, install from git.
usage: theme list | show NAME | set NAME [--mode=theme|dark|light|auto] [--keep-wallpaper] | random | next | mode theme|dark|light|auto | install GIT_URL [--name=N] [--force] | import PATH [--name=N] [--force] | remove NAME | status [--dry-run] [--json]
commands.note: A theme colours the bar, terminals, btop, Neovim and (on Plasma) the colour scheme.

commands.name: appearance
commands.summary: Bar, dock, windows, animations, layout, fonts and backgrounds, one setting at a time.
usage: appearance bar show|hide|toggle | position top|bottom|left|right | style opaque|glassy|clear | clock ID | battery on|off
appearance dock show|hide|toggle | mode always|autohide|off | position bottom|left|right
appearance windows gaps on|off | corners theme|rounded|sharp | opacity opaque|glassy | one-window-ratio on|off
appearance font list | ID | install ID [--yes]
appearance background list | set NAME_OR_PATH | next | random
commands.note: Settings act at once (no --yes); --dry-run shows the commands. What you choose is remembered, and `appearance apply` pushes it again.

commands.name: display
commands.summary: Monitors: scale, rotation, mode, position, mirroring the laptop panel, turning it off, brightness.
commands.note: On Hyprland it writes theme/monitors.lua and reloads; on Plasma it uses kscreen-doctor.

commands.name: power
commands.summary: Laptop power: profile, lid action, setup of the power tools, doctor.
commands.note: `power setup` does nothing on a machine without a battery unless you add --force.

commands.name: time
commands.summary: The time zone: show, set, set from your IP after travelling, follow your location, network time.
commands.note: `time auto on` sends your Wi-Fi networks or IP address to a location web service; the plan says so first.

commands.name: toggle
commands.summary: Quick switches. Today: stay awake (Noctalia caffeine).

commands.name: nightshift
commands.summary: Night light: on, off, toggle, status (sunset to sunrise from your time zone).

commands.name: notify
commands.summary: Notifications through Noctalia: do not disturb, snooze, history, clear.

groups.title: System and security
groups.blurb: Updates, snapshots, DNS, kernels, keys and secrets.

commands.name: system
commands.summary: Update the system (a snapshot first), lock, suspend, log out, reboot, shut down.
commands.note: lock and suspend act at once; logout, reboot and shutdown need --yes (the menu asks first).

commands.name: security
commands.summary: Fingerprint and security key for sudo, SSH server, passwordless sudo, with guards.
commands.note: Only /etc/pam.d/sudo is ever changed, with a `sufficient` line and a backup; sudoers is checked with visudo first. `--dry-run` prints the exact line.

commands.name: dns
commands.summary: DNS servers of the active connections: Cloudflare, Google, Quad9, your own, or back to DHCP.

commands.name: kernel
commands.summary: List, install and remove kernels. Never edits the bootloader.
usage: kernel list | install NAME | remove NAME [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: ssh
commands.summary: Create an SSH key (ed25519; an existing one is kept).

commands.name: secrets
commands.summary: API keys and tokens in the system keyring, loaded per command, exported encrypted.
usage: secrets status | setup [--keyring=kwallet|gnome-keyring|none] [--yes] | list [--type=ai|other] | set NAME [--from-file=F] [--type=ai|other] [--provider=ID] | get NAME [--show] | unset NAME --yes | apply [--yes] | global on NAME --yes|off NAME|show | unlock | lock | export FILE [--plain] [--force] --yes | import FILE [--overwrite] --yes | env [NAMES...] | run [NAMES...] [--strict] -- COMMAND [ARGS...] [--json]

commands.name: vpn
commands.summary: VPN post-install steps for NordVPN.

commands.name: cloud
commands.summary: Cloud storage with rclone: remotes, mounts as systemd user units.
usage: cloud remotes | configure | mount NAME [--path=DIR] [--yes] | unmount NAME [--yes] | status [--json]

commands.name: settings
commands.summary: Export and import your BxCachy settings as one archive.

commands.name: dotfiles
commands.summary: Apply your dotfiles repo with chezmoi, yadm, stow or plain links, never overwriting unasked, with undo.
usage: dotfiles plan REPO [--method=chezmoi|yadm|stow|links] | apply REPO [--method=M] [--overwrite] [--yes] [--dry-run] | status | undo [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: nas
commands.summary: Your NAS boxes: find them, save their details, list shares, mount them (also automatically), test them, mirror folders to them, use one as a backup target.
usage: nas list | show NAME | remove NAME [--yes]
examples: bxcachy nas auto on synology backups --yes
commands.note: SMB mounts are made by root, so the password is also kept in /etc/bxcachy/nas/NAME.cred (mode 600); the plan says so. The SMB version is negotiated unless you give --vers. Nothing on the NAS is deleted unless you add --delete to a sync.

commands.name: backup
commands.summary: Backups of your BxCachy setup, of the system and of your files, and a way to move them around.
usage: backup config list | show ID | diff ID
backup config paths | add PATH | remove PATH
backup snapshots delete ID | changes ID | restore ID PATH [--yes]
backup data list [--target=NAME] | files ID [PATH] | restore ID --to=DIR [--include=PATH] [--yes]
examples: bxcachy backup data target add do --type=s3 --endpoint=https://nyc3.digitaloceanspaces.com --bucket=mybackups --ask-keys
commands.note: A config snapshot is taken by itself before update, system update, init, reinstall and refresh (turn it off with backup config auto off). Secrets and SSH keys are never in it unless you add --with-secrets, which stores your secrets export, encrypted with a passphrase you type.

commands.name: timemachine
commands.summary: The Time Machine screen: every backup of your system, setup and files on one timeline, with browse, restore, export and send.
commands.note: It needs a terminal. Restore, export, send and back up now show the plan first and change nothing until you press y. --local skips the network targets so it opens at once; --demo shows made-up data and runs nothing.

groups.title: Develop
groups.blurb: BoxLang, editors, databases, containers, virtual machines and AI agents.

commands.name: boxlang
commands.summary: BoxLang status, modules (ForgeBox), the VS Code extension, links.
usage: boxlang status | use VERSION | matchbox use VERSION | modules list|search TEXT|install SLUG...|installed|outdated|update | vscode | links | welcome [--json]

commands.name: editor
commands.summary: Neovim with LazyVim, the BoxLang plugin and themes that follow the BxCachy theme.

commands.name: db
commands.summary: Databases as containers (Podman or Docker): PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, Couchbase, vector stores.
usage: db engines | list | start ENGINE [--name N] [--port P] [--password-file FILE | --ask-password] [--yes] [--dry-run] | stop|status|logs ENGINE [--name N] | remove ENGINE [--name N] [--keep-data] --yes | info ENGINE [--name N] [--show-password] | engine [podman|docker] | menu [--json]

commands.name: containers
commands.summary: Podman helpers: doctor, rootless socket, docker compatibility wrappers.

commands.name: vm
commands.summary: Virtual machines in containers: Windows (dockur) and Linux desktops (webtop), with sizes and status.
usage: vm list | status [NAME] | size [NAME] | info NAME [--show-password] | doctor | versions linux|windows | create windows [NAME] [--version=V] [--ram=8G] [--cpus=N] [--disk=64G] [--share=PATH|none] | create linux NAME [--tag=ubuntu-xfce] [--cpus=N] [--memory=4G] [--share=PATH|none] [--gpu=none|auto|intel|amd|nvidia] | start|stop|logs NAME | open NAME [--web] [--fullscreen] | remove NAME [--keep-data] [--yes] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: ai
commands.summary: AI agents: list, default, launch, tmux sessions, local models, the pull-down AI shell.
usage: ai session start [ID] [--name=N] [--dir=PATH] [--dry-run] | list | attach NAME | stop NAME --yes [--json]
ai models list | ps | pull NAME | rm NAME --yes | status | enable [--yes] [--json]
ai list | default [ID] [--yes] | launch [ID] [--dry-run] | session ... | models ... | shell [toggle|status] [--backend=hyprland|yakuake] [--dry-run] [--json]

commands.name: skills
commands.summary: Agent skills for BoxLang and BxCachy: install, update, remove.
usage: skills list [--tag=T] | search TEXT | show OWNER/REPO/SLUG | install [bxcachy|boxlang|matchbox|OWNER/REPO/SLUG]... [--yes] | installed | update [--yes] | remove NAME [--yes] | status | link [--json]

groups.title: Everyday tools
groups.blurb: Screenshots, clipboard, windows, dictation and hardware helpers.

commands.name: screenshot
commands.summary: Screenshots: screen, region, window, OCR text, QR codes, or a menu.

commands.name: qr
commands.summary: Make a QR code from text (printed in the terminal, or saved with --out).

commands.name: record
commands.summary: Screen recording: start, stop, toggle.

commands.name: clipboard
commands.summary: Clipboard history (cliphist): pick, list, clear, setup.

commands.name: emoji
commands.summary: The emoji picker (rofimoji).

commands.name: forcequit
commands.summary: Pick a window or process and force quit it.

commands.name: window
commands.summary: Minimize and restore windows.

commands.name: overview
commands.summary: The workspace and window overview.

commands.name: quicklook
commands.summary: Quick Look for files (Kiview): preview with a key.

commands.name: dolphin
commands.summary: Dolphin diagnostics: why it is slow or missing features.

commands.name: dictation
commands.summary: Dictation with Superwhisper or Voxtype: setup and toggle.

commands.name: strata
commands.summary: Strata, the file manager: its integrations.

commands.name: gpu
commands.summary: GPU check: driver, rendering, NVIDIA specifics.

commands.name: input
commands.summary: Input devices: doctor, trackpad gestures.

commands.name: airplay
commands.summary: AirPlay receiver: on, off, status.
